BrochureContent.Content:
Hume Auctioneers - We get the pick of the crop. 

This delightful three-bedroom semi-detached residence is perhaps the finest of its type to come to the market for some time. One of the very few houses in Fairgreen to have its own gated front garden, the property immediately stands out.

Owner occupied, the house has been meticulously maintained by its current owners and from the day it was built and now comes to the market with a host of extras and in breathtakingly good condition.

With its own front garden and enjoying a superb setting in the original showhouse enclave, the property enjoys immense kerb appeal.

 Step into the welcoming hallway and the excellent layout of this stunning home will immediately charm. 

The sitting room enjoys a large picture window, filling the room with natural light. With a feature fireplace and beautiful wood floors, this is an excellent room for relaxation right throughout the year. 

Double doors lead to the kitchen dining room offering a fabulous open plan feeling.

 The kitchen dining room also enjoys superb natural light via a large picture window and double patio doors with a direct south facing aspect. Once again everything is presented in pristine condition with professionally painted cabinetry and full interiors freshly painted. This room with its beautiful Modern white kitchen, integrated appliances and extensive dining area is superbly appointed. 

A guest WC completes the ground floor accommodation.

 On the first floor, there are three spacious bedrooms. The front double enjoys excellent light, with the master boasting exceptional built in wardrobes and a large en-suite.
 A single bedroom to the front enjoys a beautiful aspect and built in wardrobes. 

A beautiful bathroom completes the accommodation. 

The entire has been freshly painted and with new carpets and a host of extras it feels once again like the original showhouse it was.

To the rear is a wonderful garden ideal for family living. There is a fabulous lawn and a magnificent insulated steel shed, professionally wired. A gate leads to substantial private parking and a small lane giving excellent access to the side and rear. 

The property is vacant and chain-free, meaning a fast move is possible. 

Fairgreen is exceptionally convenient. Within walking distance of schools, train station, town centre and restaurants, everything is at hand.

 And now with the recent opening of Tesco express within the development, the location has got even better. 

Fibre broadband to the door. Gas central heating. 

Viewing of this exceptional home is highly recommended. 

The new Portlaoise Bus service has a stop 1 minute walk from the property, giving round the clock access to Hospital, Train Station, Town Centre and Schools.
